I have farmed these lands for many years, and for this small plot of root crops, I will plant the local cassava cuttings I saved from last season. I will not buy chemical fertilizer, pesticides, or irrigation because this plot is too small to justify the cost, and the rains here in the South South are usually enough. My children and grandchildren will help with the planting and harvesting, so I do not need to pay hired workers.
